description: Header file defining the omi::OmiProxy class, which implements the IOmiProxy interface for managing crypted bundles and listener registration in the omi namespace.

classes.name: OmiProxy
classes.description: A class that implements the IOmiProxy interface, providing methods for mounting/unmounting crypted bundles and registering/unregistering listeners.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given its id, root filesystem path, and configuration, outputting the bundle path.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle identified by its id.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener with associated callback parameters, returns a tag identifier.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered listener using its tag.
